The layoffs will be carried out in a socially responsible manner, a company spokesperson told the newswire.

"HSBC is focused on strengthening its ​leadership position ​and ⁠market share in the areas where it has ​competitive advantages and sees ​the ⁠greatest opportunities for growth and supporting clients," said the spokesperson.
